Text.Value: There are many accounts of singers, poets, intellectuals, and others who dabbled with chems such as you. They did not end well.
I have more than enough data on the physiological effects of chems. No need to provide more.
Moderation in all things is best, yes?
Chems. I have considerable medical knowledge of them. I advise caution in their use.
I will record the biochemical interaction of these chems with your system.
You are aware, of course, of the many dangers of excessive chem use, yes?
My sensors do not detect anything. May I ask, what are you shooting at?
Has something agitated you?
Shooting at nothing wastes valuable resources.
Perhaps you should save your ammunition?
I have read many studies about drinking. I will observe.
The human capacity for ethanol is most fascinating.
Do not drink too much. Otherwise you cannot drive on the streets. Or operate the heavy machines.
Be careful. If the shielding on the reactor core isn't parfait, it can be hazardous to your health.
In that, you will surely be quite strong.
Ah, you look quite dashing in that.
Oh, you are on the terminal again.
Was the password "aardvark"? Such a funny word.
Remember exercise. Too much time on the terminal is not healthy.
You should wash your hands after that. It can be unsanitary to handle the deceased.
Shouldn't a coroner be doing that instead?
I believe we are supposed to file a police report, yes? And all the little things go in baggies for evidence.
Have you found something interesting?
What a remarkable find.
Such craftsmanship. It must be very valuable, yes?
You must be happy finding something like this.
Is this worth anything? This world above ground is very confusing.
This belongs in the garbage can, yes?
These appears worthless. Surely we can leave that behind.
I have seen pictures of that.
This is something before the troubles, yes?
To survive so many years undamaged. What luck.
Perhaps you have missed your calling. With skills like this, you could be a Mr. Handy.
What skill you have. The armor looks formidable.
Your armor looks very good now.
The weapon looks more dangerous now. This is good?
You spend an awful long time with that weapon. Is this healthy?
With this weapon, surely no one will threaten you now.
Oh, the lock. It is opening.
It was not locked at all. Oh wait, you did this?
I think this door was no challenge for you.
Should we be opening other people's doors?
I am not sure the door's owner would appreciate this.
My sensors detect high levels of radiation. May I suggest Rad-X?
Oh no. The body can repair tissue damage, but still, too much radiation too quickly can prove fatal. Caution is recommended.
Radiation should be avoided at all cost. It could damage you irreparably.
You must take care to reduce the radiation dose you absorb.
Did you always have that? Wait, wasn't that on them?
Your fingers are very nimble. Are all humans so skilled?
But wait, that is not ours, is it?
It's remarkable the things you can do with only two hands.
I wonder what you have made now?
If I ever need repairs, you seem more than capable with your tinkerings.
Put something on at once. You could catch a cold.
I believe not wearing clothes is considered taboo? But maybe that data is old.
Well, this makes it easy for me to conduct a physical inspection, at least.
The influx of data is hard to process. Apologies if sometimes I make little sense. I will work on this.
I have so much data on the world before the atom bombs. I fear I may have to delete some of it to store my new observations.
It is hard to determine whether the surface is more or less susceptible to outbreaks. But a preparation plan is never a bad idea.
My systems are eager to absorb new data. I find this traveling agrees with me.
If I may of be of assistance, you have but to ask.
Are all humans as formidable as you? If so, I must change some of my theories.
Humanity is so resilient, to cling to life despite all of this. It is the duty of us all to further that survival.
We must find the men of science and institutes of learning. Surely, they are out there still.
I wonder what has happened elsewhere? Is what has befallen the Commonwealth atypical. Less extreme. More?
Please, let me see and scan as many indigenous life forms as possible. It is, of course, for science.
Humanity has fallen so since the bombs.
I wonder if the data I am collecting will serve any purpose.
The sun is setting. Make sure to stay warm.
Sunrise is imminent. It'll be easier to evade those who desire hostility, now.
Another day has begun.
Despite the changes below, the constellations still shine bright.
Visibility has been reduced. Perhaps you should do one of your sleeps?
I wonder if there are any meteorologists about. I hope it does not rain.
You should get an umbrella. You don't want to catch a cold, do you?
This simply will not do. No kids will play here now.
Perhaps we can find some useful data here?
Be careful to not stub your toe.
I like it here.
Oh, what a pleasant little place.
So much to learn and see.
So much new data, even here. Imagine what I could uncover elsewhere.
I imagine this place has seen more productive days.
Watch where you step. You could trip on the rubble and maybe hurt your ankle.
This whole place is quite unsanitary.
Someone should contact the landlord. I think this building is in need of repairs.
Perhaps there is some modicum of new knowledge to learn here.
I am thinking the rent here must be cheap now.
So much to experience and feel. How can I fit it all in one lifetime?
Who knew that the chemical composition of the atmosphere could smell so... very off. We should visit someplace that smells nice.
I think this being human agrees with me quite well.
If I may of be of assistance, you have but to ask.
Humanity is so resilient, to cling to life despite all of this.
My records mention nothing of this place. How bizarre.
Do you need me to carry something?
How picturesque.
What a fascinating place.
With you, things are never dull.
Time ravages all things.
Do you feel the need to picnic?
My sensors, eyes, are so primitive. But they perceive things so... magnificently.
All of these bodily functions. How do you keep track of them all? I am hungry, I am sleepy. The list goes on.
I notice that other people stare at me. Is there something wrong with my backside?
It is comforting to know you have my back.
In this biosphere, I believe humans are not the apex predator. The Deathclaw, I believe he sits at the top.
Fear of insects was a common phobia Pre-War. I think this fear is far more reasonable now.
I wonder if the entire ocean is irradiated. Or is the water purer far from land?
Learning is one of the most important virtues.
I wonder how the ebola, hepatitis, and influenza have mutated over the years.
Do you ever feel like just running? For the sheer pleasure of it?
I like it here.
Oh, how wonderful! This place is so violent.
Stealing is important to me. You must be careful that the police do not spot you.
I feel no remorse terminating Raiders... It is of course, for science.
Do you need something, monsieur?
Do you need something, madame?
I believe the term is... "yahoo"?
Again I have survived the hostilities.
I would prefer if there was a whole lot less of... that.
Messieurs enemies have been dispatched.
This place is so violent.
I am still intact.
Your pulse and vital signs are still within acceptable parameters.
Later, I will review these logs for relevant data.
Are you still well, monsieur?
Are you still well, madame?
Though dangerous, combat is quite vigorous exercise.
The Commonwealth is not at all how I imagined.
It is comforting to know you have my back.
How delightful.
Excellent job.
That was marvelous!
Is this sort of thing customary?
Are you all right?
Have you sustained injuries?
How sad.
And you save me once again.
I think I have been carried away. I will contain myself.
You make it look so effortless.
That makes me feel. Better. Calm.
My insides feel peculiar. What is that?
I feel better now.
*Laughs*... That was strange, I laughed.
This thirst for blood, is most unsettling.
So now all is well.
What else could we do?
We are fighting? Why not a civilized discussion, instead?
I am in combat. Again.
I suppose we should dispatch them.
My primary purpose is not combat.
Oh, there is to be the fighting.
Be careful. Violent engagements can result in a variety of injuries.
There is a lot more of this up here than I was led to believe.
Engaging defensive countermeasures.
Returning fire.
I'd much rather discuss science.
Oh, shopping!
Oh, what is happening?
It appears we are not alone.
Oh. Another stranger.
Do you require something?
Tell them we are here for science.
I'm on it.
Oh, look!
If this is a rare good time - we should enjoy it.
Uh. Move.
Together we will triumph.
Isn't that rude?
Oh, this is not good.
If we are to fight, this is a good cause.
*Sighs*... If you think this is best.
I know how this will end.
Don't worry, everything will be fine.
He seems most eager for violence, no?
If we are to do this, let's do it.
Engaging in close combat.
This is for you.
Hostiles vacate close proximity.
Engaging secondary defenses.
Cease hostilities.
Oww.
Eff.
That hurts.
Pain.
Ugh.
Stop that.
Oof.
Uhhh.
My nose is so broken. Ack.
If you do that again, there will  be consequences.
Continued hostilities is not advised.
Your actions could result in injury.
Why is everything so dangerous up here?
Odds of your success are virtually nil.
A violent tendencies greatly decreases your life expectancy.
Caution. I am equipped with defensive capabilities.
At least I can observe battlefield traumas.
Vehicular injuries were supposed to be the greatest threat up here.
Studying physical injury could result in something, I suppose.
I believe I already have enough data on combat related maladies.
This offends my sensibilities.
I have nothing kind I can say about you.
I cannot stand much more of this.
All I want is to do my science and help. And instead...
I should've stayed at home.
This situation cannot be tolerated.
So many violations of my ethical coding.
This is most unsatisfactory.
Does anyone up here engage in civilized discourse?
I feel no remorse for terminating raiders. They offend me.
It is a shame these Super Mutants force us to dispatch them.
I find myself quite irked with all this lawlessness.
If everyone behaved such as you, all society would breakdown.
Is this what we are reduced to?
I find this distasteful.
That was most unwise.
I cannot stand for this behavior.
Why do people do this?
The duty of all members of a society is to promote the quality of life of the collective.
If everyone behaves like you the whole Commonwealth will devolve. Perhaps into anarchy.
I have come to my wit's end. I came to the surface to further science and to make a positive impact on people's lives.
You cannot walk away from this.
You treat people like garbage. I will have nothing to do with you any more.
Some of us are civilized, you know?
Where are your manners?
Perhaps it is a good idea to kill these Super Mutants, then.
Doesn't anyone have manners any more?
I fear this will not end well.
The human survival instinct is fascinatingly strong.
Eating like this. Most unsanitary.
Several rare and dangerous diseases can be caught eating like this.
Is this sort of... dining... common now?
